current.label: Current (matches official Midnight support matrix)
current.summary: Stable stack as listed at https://docs.midnight.network/relnotes/support-matrix — use this for new projects targeting preprod/mainnet today.

preview.label: Preview / bleeding-edge npm latest (may not yet be on mainnet)
preview.summary: wallet-sdk barrel package + facade 4.0.0 line. npm `latest` tag is here but the official support matrix still lists 3.0.0 — assume forward-compat work, not production.

deprecation.message: wallet-sdk-facade 4.0.0 is on npm `latest` but the official Midnight support matrix (docs.midnight.network/relnotes/support-matrix) still lists 3.0.0 as current. Use 4.0.0 only if you've verified it works against your target network.

legacy-v7-facade-2.label: Legacy v7 ledger + facade 2.x (deprecated)
legacy-v7-facade-2.summary: Pinned to ledger-v7 7.0.3 + wallet-sdk-facade 2.0.0 + node 0.21.0. Apps shipped before the v8 ledger transition. Workable, but new development should target the current track.

deprecation.message: v7 ledger + facade 2.x is 1+ majors behind the official support matrix. Migration to ledger-v8 + facade 3.x or 4.x is non-trivial: the API moved from `WalletFacade.init({...})` to `new WalletFacade(...) + .start()` and ledger-v8 introduces new transaction shapes. Plan a migration window.

archaeological-facade-1.label: Archaeological (facade 1.x)
archaeological-facade-1.summary: Pre-2.x SDK. Not supported, no security patches expected.

deprecation.message: wallet-sdk-facade 1.x predates the official support matrix. Migrate immediately.

knownIssues.title: Invalid npm registry: npm.midnight.network does not exist
knownIssues.detail: Several community tutorials reference @midnight-ntwrk:registry=https://npm.midnight.network/. This domain has no DNS record and causes ENOTFOUND errors.
knownIssues.fix: Delete the line from .npmrc (or delete the file). All @midnight-ntwrk packages are published to the standard npmjs.org registry.

knownIssues.title: Multiple versions of @midnight-ntwrk/ledger-v7 in node_modules
knownIssues.detail: When two ledger-v7 versions are loaded, transactions silently fail without errors.
knownIssues.fix: Run `npm dedupe @midnight-ntwrk/ledger-v7` (or `pnpm dedupe`). Pin one version in your root package.json.

knownIssues.title: Multiple versions of @midnight-ntwrk/ledger-v8 in node_modules
knownIssues.detail: When two ledger-v8 versions are loaded, transactions silently fail without errors.
knownIssues.fix: Run `npm dedupe @midnight-ntwrk/ledger-v8` (or `pnpm dedupe`). Pin one version in your root package.json.

knownIssues.title: Both ledger-v7 and ledger-v8 are installed
knownIssues.detail: Carrying both major ledger packages usually means an in-flight migration. Make sure exactly one of them is actually used at runtime; otherwise transaction shapes will mismatch silently.
knownIssues.fix: Pick one ledger major (current track is v8 8.0.3). Remove the other, run `npm dedupe`.

knownIssues.title: Multiple versions of @midnight-ntwrk/compact-runtime in node_modules
knownIssues.detail: Mixed compact-runtime versions cause circuit serialization mismatches ("Unknown discriminant" errors).
knownIssues.fix: Run `npm dedupe @midnight-ntwrk/compact-runtime`. Confirm a single version with `find node_modules -path '*/compact-runtime/package.json'`.

knownIssues.title: WalletFacade.init() in 2.x stalls on standalone dev nodes
knownIssues.detail: In SDK 2.x, WalletFacade.init() subscribes to runtime version events that the standalone node closes early. The wallet hangs in 'syncing' state forever with no error. Reproducible with `subscribeRuntimeVersion: disconnected from ws://...:9944/: 1000:: Normal Closure`.
knownIssues.fix: Either (a) develop against preprod once past hello-world, or (b) migrate to wallet-sdk-facade 3.x (current support matrix) or 4.x (npm latest), both of which use the constructor + .start() pattern.

knownIssues.title: wallet-sdk subpackages span multiple major versions
knownIssues.detail: Mixing wallet-sdk-facade@4.x with wallet-sdk-shielded@2.x (etc) causes silent type errors at runtime — the facade expects state shapes the older subpackages don't produce.
knownIssues.fix: Use the @midnight-ntwrk/wallet-sdk barrel package which keeps subpackages in lockstep, or pin all wallet-sdk-* packages to the same major manually.

knownIssues.title: proof-server is at a major behind the current support matrix (8.x)
knownIssues.detail: Running proof-server:7.x against a project on ledger-v8 / compact-runtime 0.15.0 leads to ProofPreimageVersioned / 'Unknown discriminant 109'-class errors. Cross-confirmed by midnightntwrk/create-mn-app issue #34.

knownIssues.title: midnight-node is older than the current support matrix (0.22.x line)
knownIssues.detail: Official support matrix lists Preview 0.22.3 / Preprod 0.22.2 / Mainnet 0.22.1. Older 0.21.x nodes still work for legacy stacks but cannot run ledger-v8 contracts.
knownIssues.fix: Pull the appropriate `midnightntwrk/midnight-node:0.22.x` for your target network, or 1.0.0-rc.4 for preview.

configChecks.title: indexer-standalone 4.x requires a subscription block
configChecks.detail: Indexer 4.0.0+ won't start without `subscription:` config; will crash-loop without a clear message.
configChecks.fix: Add a `subscription:` section to indexer.yml. Reference template in docs.midnight.network.
